title: OpenClaw Windows Gateway clean repair
backup: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$bk=Join-Path $root ('gateway-repair-'+(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'));New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bk|Out-Null;$state=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw';foreach($f in @('gateway.cmd','gateway.vbs')){$p=Join-Path $state $f;if(Test-Path $p){Copy-Item $p $bk -Force}};$task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'OpenClaw Gateway' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if($null -ne $task){Export-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'OpenClaw Gateway'|Set-Content (Join-Path $bk 'OpenClaw-Gateway.xml') -Encoding UTF8};Write-Output ('V414_052W_BACKUP='+$bk)
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$state=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw';function OC([string[]]$OcArgs,[string]$Tag){$out=Join-Path $root ($Tag+'.txt');$r=& openclaw.cmd @OcArgs 2>&1;$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;@($r)|Out-String|Set-Content $out -Encoding UTF8;return $ec};$null=OC @('gateway','stop') '052w-stop';$null=OC @('gateway','uninstall') '052w-uninstall';$task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'OpenClaw Gateway' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;if($null -ne $task){Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'OpenClaw Gateway' -Confirm:$false};Remove-Item (Join-Path $state 'gateway.vbs'),(Join-Path $state 'gateway.cmd') -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$install=OC @('gateway','install','--force') '052w-install';if($install -ne 0){$install=OC @('gateway','install') '052w-install-fallback';if($install -ne 0){throw ('GATEWAY_INSTALL_FAILED code='+$install)}};$ok=$false;for($i=0;$i -lt 15;$i++){Start-Sleep -Seconds 2;$raw=& openclaw.cmd gateway status --json 2>&1;$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;if($ec -eq 0){try{$rawText=($raw|Out-String);$null=$rawText|ConvertFrom-Json;$rawText|Set-Content (Join-Path $root '052w-status.json') -Encoding UTF8;$ok=$true;break}catch{}}};if(-not $ok){throw 'GATEWAY_STATUS_NOT_HEALTHY_JSON'};Write-Output 'V414_052W_GATEWAY_REPAIR=PASS'
